steps: Sign up for free on Branded Surveys and answer the demographic profile questions so the Survey Matching Engine can match you with surveys.
Log in to your dashboard; qualified surveys appear with their point value and estimated completion time shown up front — click to take them.
Answer honestly and completely; points deposit into your account when you finish each survey.
Once you reach a minimum of 500 approved points, use the redemption button in 'My Points' to cash out via PayPal (third-party sources: 500 points = $5).
Stay active and consistent — the Branded Elite loyalty program adds bonus rewards (third-party: up to 15%+ for 25+ surveys/month).
timing: Official page does not state processing time; third-party sources report approximately 1–2 business days.
